lastText: File ClosedArmed for a War That Became an AllianceContestedImperial General Headquarters, Beginning 1939Years spent bankrupting the civilian economy to prepare for a war that never came instead buy something else: Washington's containment strategy finds real use for a permanently mobilized, anti-communist Japan the enemy-state question never fully closed off. The spending built a harder bargaining position, not the war it was built for. What that bargaining position is actually built on is real: an empire that reaches as far as an actual invasion of northern Australia was seriously attempted, the resource area's furthest possible extent under this command, held without ever having to fight the war that, historically, cost Japan every acre of it.The Theater Map at the end of the warPacific Situation · The war as it ended · Theater MapJapan: ContestedFormosa: ContestedManchukuo: ContestedNorth China: ContestedEast China: ContestedGuangdong: ContestedHunan-Guangxi: Allied-controlled / liberatedFree China: Allied-controlled / liberatedYan'an: Allied-controlled / liberatedTibet & Xinjiang: Neutral / not yet contestedIndochina: ContestedThailand: ContestedBurma: Allied-controlled / liberatedIndia: Allied-controlled / liberatedMalaya: ContestedSumatra: ContestedJava: ContestedBorneo: ContestedCelebes: ContestedMoluccas & Timor: ContestedLuzon: Allied-controlled / liberatedVisayas: Allied-controlled / liberatedMindanao: Allied-controlled / liberatedNew Guinea: Allied-controlled / lib
